name: eSUN ASA+ @BBL X2D 0.4 nozzle
description: eSUN ASA+ on Bambu Lab X2D 0.4 mm. Vendor numbers from eSUN's official H2D ASA+ profile (2026-11-02): flow 0.96, 260 C, 24.99/kg, 1.04 g/cm3. Chamber raised to 60 C (eSUN ship 50, Bambu's own ASA uses 65) because ASA's failure mode is warping and layer splitting. Part fan cut to 35%. Volumetric speed 18/25/18/18/20/18 - Bambu's ASA ceilings, which lift the 0.45 mm wall/infill cap from 185 to 208 mm/s. Bed temperatures inherited from Bambu ASA on this printer.
